title: No source gives the wire shapes, the value sets or the dependency rows this story needs: the append request and answer, the evaluation and run reads, the case-less approval row, the promotion decision code, the text of MSG-P7-009, the name behind EV-30 and the DP-02 login name
source: Legacy RWB-E2-029 sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14 against TSD P7 v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.3, T-A.1 and T-A.2, FSD P7 v3 A2.2.4.3, A2.4.3.1 and A2.7, the context pack of P7 rwb-decision and Architecture v5 slides 13, 14 and 41
description: The legacy story fixes the facts of the promotion and of the rejected proposal and none of the shapes. (1) The append has no path and no method in this service: TSD P7 v2 T-A.1 documents only the recommendation, approval and ledger reads, while the legacy writes the entry in process, so the write path of the target is assumed as POST /decision-log with the request and answer of section 12.1. (2) The two reads of rwb-agent are consumed without a documented request or answer: the legacy names POST /admin/agent-evaluations and GET /cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs of the monolith base, and the fields the record needs (per-code precision and recall, sample size, agent and prompt version, mode, data date) are neither TSD nor FSD objects of P7. (3) The `approval` row of a policy promotion has no case, while TSD P7 v2 T3.1 makes `approval.case_id` required, and no column of that table names the segment pair or the condition set, which this story carries in `source_ref` and `terms`. (4) The promotion decision code is a value of LOV-DECISION that no source enumerates, and the enumeration of LOV-DECISION is absent from TSD P7 v2 T3.2. (5) The text of MSG-P7-009 is named by FSD P7 v3 A2.2.4.3 and written out in no source this story may read. (6) The Ownership Map gives P7 a third event, EV-30, whose name and payload no source this story may read writes out. (7) The name of the per-service database login of DP-02 is not given. (8) The metadata rows name no build dependency and the agent contract only, while the DP table of the story adds five platform contracts and two rwb-case contracts and the story consumes a further authorise and a freshness operation that no pattern and no metadata row names.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-029 section 8 BR2 to BR7, section 12 ('GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs', 'POST /api/recovery/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/feedback', 'POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/agent-evaluations', 'POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/agent-configs', EV-01, EV-16, EV-28, EV-06), section 13 and section 14 (MSG-P7-005, MSG-P7-003, MSG-GEN-004, MSG-P10-001, MSG-S8-001, MSG-P4-002); TSD P7 v2 T3.1 (decision_log_entry DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-031 and approval DF-DEC-032 to DF-DEC-053 with case_id required), T3.2 (LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-APPROVAL-STATUS, LOV-CAPABILITY, LOV-PRODUCT and no LOV-DECISION list), T5.3 (DecisionRecorded, ApprovalRequested) and T-A.1 (API-P7-001 to API-P7-008); FSD P7 v3 A2.2.4.3 AC-EXC-P7-002-05 (MSG-P7-009 naming decisionCode), A2.4.3.1 VR-P7-004-1, VR-P7-004-2 and VR-P7-004-3, A2.7.4.1 AC-P7-007-01; context pack P7 (Events EV-08, EV-09, EV-30; Jobs JOB-13, JOB-14, JOB-20; Workflow ApprovalWorkflow); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-03, DP-05, DP-06, DP-07, DP-09, DP-11, DP-13 and DP-19; Architecture v5 slide 13 (P7 row), slide 14 and slide 41
area: Service contract, schema variant, dependency map and build sequencing, P7 rwb-decision
owner_role: Solution architect, P7 rwb-decision, with the P10 rwb-agent owner, the rwb-case owner, the data steward and the delivery lead
proposed: Agree at the wave 2 contract review of RWB-P10-E2029-CON and of this service: the append on POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log with the request and the DecisionRecord answer of section 12.1; the evaluation and run reads with their field sets; the case-less promotion variant of `approval` with the columns that carry the segment and the condition set; LOV-DECISION with the promotion code; the text of MSG-P7-009; the name and payload of EV-30; the name of the rwb-decision login; and the nine DP-added dependency rows. Until then the story builds and tests against the values of ASM-B2-P7-002-1 to ASM-B2-P7-002-7 and the contract fakes of section 12.8.
